appDesc.message: Blocks some ad networks but leaves alone work sites.

appName.message: Ad Blocker Pro - stop invasive ads

uiAboutDesc.message: Blocks invasive ads, pop-ups and trackers, with per-site control when you need it.

uiAddPlaceholder.message: example.com — or paste a full URL

uiAllowedDesc.message: Ad Blocker Pro stands down completely on these sites — no ads or trackers are blocked there.

uiAllowedNote.message: Removing a site stops the allowance right away on this device; the shared filter update finishes the job within about 12 hours.

uiBlockedDesc.message: These sites are stopped entirely — the page itself won't load, not just its ads.

uiErrChildConflict.message: This would override more specific sites on another list — remove those entries first.

uiErrConflictAllowed.message: This site is on your Allowed list — remove it there first.

uiErrConflictBlocked.message: This site is on your Blocked list — remove it there first.

uiErrConflictPaused.message: This site is currently paused — remove it from Paused sites first.

uiErrDup.message: This site is already covered by the list.

uiErrInvalid.message: That doesn't look like a website address.

uiFeaturesDesc.message: Optional extras — switch them on or off at any time.

uiObPinHint.message: Click the puzzle piece up here to pin

uiObSubtitle.message: Ad Blocker Pro is on and already blocking ads and trackers. Two quick tips before you go:

uiObTip1Desc.message: Click the puzzle piece in your toolbar, then the pin next to Ad Blocker Pro. Your shield stays one click away.

uiObTip2Desc.message: If a site misbehaves, open the popup and flip the switch — blocking pauses for that site only, until you flip it back.

uiPausedDesc.message: Blocking is switched off on these sites — usually from the popup's pause switch. Pauses stay on this device only.

uiPopupHintActive.message: Ads and trackers are being blocked on this site.

uiPopupHintAllowed.message: This site is on your allowed list, so Ad Blocker Pro stands down here.

uiPopupHintBlocked.message: You've blocked this site entirely — it won't load at all. Manage it in settings.

uiPopupHintPaused.message: Blocking is paused here, so ads may appear. Flip the switch to resume.

uiPopupHintRestricted.message: Browser pages and the Web Store can't be filtered.

uiPopupToggleAria.message: Pause or resume blocking on this site

uiResetDesc.message: Clears your allowed, blocked and paused site lists. Filter data is unaffected.

uiStatExplainer.message: Counts every page visit where blocking was active — pages protected, not individual ads.

uiYtPopupDesc.message: Fast-forward video ads that slip through

uiYtSettingsDesc.message: Some YouTube video ads are stitched into the stream itself and can't be filtered out. With this on, they're fast-forwarded to the end the moment they start. Applies on youtube.com only.

uiYtToggleAria.message: Fast-forward YouTube video ads on or off
